lines.zh: 我在深渊里踱步，没声音。
lines.en: I pace the abyss without a sound.
Black water below; I do not care.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，可你跑不掉。
lines.en: I am not fast, but you cannot flee.
Every stone here remembers me.
I walk around the broken pillar.
Something moves in the dark: me.
My shadow stretches very long.
Step by step, I come nearer.
I am used to the abyss roads.

lines.zh: 我踩过水洼，涟漪是黑的。
lines.en: I cross a puddle; the ripples are black.
I do not look back; there is nothing.

lines.zh: 你听见的脚步声，是我的。
lines.en: Those footsteps you hear are mine.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，什么都不等。
lines.en: I stand here waiting for nothing.

lines.zh: 深渊很安静，安静得发闷。
lines.en: The abyss is quiet, stiflingly so.

lines.zh: 我没有东西可掉，也没有东西可留。
lines.en: I have nothing to drop or leave behind.
I count the water dripping overhead.

lines.zh: 它们都说我会掉宝，胡说。
lines.en: They say I drop loot; nonsense.
I touch my own ribs.
Even the wind is too lazy to come here.
When I laugh, there is no echo.

lines.zh: 我就这样待着，等一个活人。
lines.en: I wait like this for a living soul.
Darkness does not glare; I am used to it.
My hands are cold, always cold.

lines.zh: 深渊底下有什么，我知道。
lines.en: I know what lies at the abyss bottom.
I bite my nails and grind them slowly.

lines.zh: 没人来的时候，我数心跳。
lines.en: When no one comes, I count heartbeats.

lines.zh: 我把指甲咬到根，还是闲着。
lines.en: I chew my nails to the root, and I am still bored.

lines.zh: 深渊上方的光，照不到我这。
lines.en: The light above the abyss never reaches me here.

lines.zh: 你身上有光，我不太喜欢。
lines.en: You carry light; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我看看你，值不值得动手。
lines.en: Let me see if you are worth the effort.

lines.zh: 你血里的热气瞒不过我。
lines.en: Your blood smells hot.

lines.zh: 别那样看我，我不是石头。
lines.en: Do not look at me like that; I am not stone.
I know that expression of yours.

lines.zh: 你在找我的战利品？没有。
lines.en: Looking for my loot? There is none.
I tilt my head and stare at your throat.
You step back; I smile a little.

lines.zh: 深渊把你送来了，真周到。
lines.en: The abyss delivered you; how thoughtful.
Your eyes glimmer in this gloom.

lines.zh: 在我眼里，你是一顿晚饭。
lines.en: I look at you like a meal.
Do not be afraid; I am quick.

lines.zh: 你手里那把剑，挡不住我。
lines.en: That sword in your hand will not stop me.

lines.zh: 你的脸刻进我脑子里了。
lines.en: Your face is carved into my mind.
You hit me hard enough to rattle my bones.

lines.zh: 我笑了，血从牙缝里出来。
lines.en: I laugh as blood seeps between my teeth.
This little pain for your life.
I have no blood to show you.

lines.zh: 你砍下来的地方，长回去了。
lines.en: The place you cut has grown back.
I retreat half a step, then return.
A little pain sharpens my mind.
A rib is broken; I still stand.
You hear me breathing low.
That blow done, it is my turn.
Give me that bit of food in your hand.
Even moss is scarce down in this abyss.

lines.zh: 我闻到肉味，脚步就停了。
lines.en: I smell meat and my steps stop.
You raise it high; I cannot reach.
I have almost forgotten the taste of hot food.
Just toss it down; do not tease me.
I am not picky; I can swallow anything.

lines.zh: 这味道让我忘了装镇定。
lines.en: That smell makes me forget my calm.
Step back and leave the food.

lines.zh: 我饿，饿得连影子都薄了。
lines.en: I am so hungry even my shadow thinned.
Do not bump me; there is no meat on me.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我硬得像骨头。
lines.en: You bump into me; I am hard as bone.
We pass and neither gives way.
At that bump, you gave half a step.

lines.zh: 我抬起胳膊挡你这一撞。
lines.en: I raise a hand to block.
Walking the abyss, you hug the walls.

lines.zh: 我肩上的骨头硌到你了。
lines.en: The bone of my shoulder caught you.
Move; I do not like being touched.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，灰尘落下来。
lines.en: We collide and dust falls from above.

lines.zh: 你踩着我的脚了，虽然不疼。
lines.en: You stepped on my foot, though it does not hurt.

lines.zh: 深渊里也有同伴，只是少。
lines.en: Even the abyss has companions, few of them.

lines.zh: 我们不拥抱，只并肩站着。
lines.en: We do not embrace; we stand side by side.

lines.zh: 它和我一样，什么都不掉。
lines.en: Like me, it drops nothing at all.
Our young bite from the moment they are born.

lines.zh: 两个影子叠在一处，很暗。
lines.en: Two shadows overlap and grow very dark.
It watches the road behind me.
We never speak, yet we understand.

lines.zh: 深渊会记住我们的味道。
lines.en: The abyss will remember our scent.
It is thinner than I; I leave it meat.

lines.zh: 夜里它靠着我，像块冷石。
lines.en: At night it leans on me like cold stone.
I keep this bone from the ground.
Whatever fell here is mine now.
I lift it and sniff before keeping it.
This is worthless, but I want it.
While I bend down, you had best stay still.

lines.zh: 深渊里捡到的，都是别人的。
lines.en: What you find in the abyss belonged to someone.

lines.zh: 我把它塞进腰间的破布。
lines.en: I stuff it into the rag at my waist.

lines.zh: 你丢的东西，我替你保管。
lines.en: You dropped it; I will hold it.
This stone is slightly warm.
I never ask where a thing came from.
You walked in; now you are mine.
I smell something living.
The abyss has closed its door.
Do not run; there is only one road.

lines.zh: 你的心跳，我隔着皮都听见。
lines.en: I hear your heartbeat through your skin.
I turn my head toward you.
Another one come to die.
I am in no hurry; you cannot leave.
This prey stands rather straight.

lines.zh: 你的影子已经出卖你了。
lines.en: Your shadow has already betrayed you.
I have fixed on you.
The abyss enjoys the smell of newcomers.
I pace around you, watching closely.
The tip of your sword trembles.
I close in, then pull back.
I move after you strike first.
The darkness here favors me.
I have counted every step you took.
Wall behind you, me in front.
Even my breathing makes no sound.
The more you tense, the happier I am.
I am waiting for your mistake.
In the dark, my eyes shine brightest.
You look for an exit and find none.

lines.zh: 这一回，我不打算放你走。
lines.en: This time I do not plan to let you go.
This claw tears open your sleeve.
My nails are black.

lines.zh: 你挡得住一下，挡不住两下。
lines.en: You block one blow, not two.
I laugh while I hit you.

lines.zh: 这一下只用了八点五的力。
lines.en: That blow used only eight and a half.
You back to the water; careful.
My claws hook into your collar.

lines.zh: 骨头撞骨头的声音，好听。
lines.en: Bone on bone is a lovely sound.
You double over in pain; perfect.
I strike for no loot at all.
I crawl out of the black water.
The abyss opens another eye.
The air here is cold and rank.

lines.zh: 我先看看四周有没有光。
lines.en: First I check the surroundings for light.
No one comes to greet me.
The stone underfoot is wet.
I shake the black water away.
The abyss is deep; I fell slowly.
The world above is far from me.

lines.zh: 我站起来，骨头响了一声。
lines.en: I stand and my bones creak once.

lines.zh: 又有活物在这片黑暗里。
lines.en: Another living thing is in this dark.
I smell the world above on the air.
This time I will stay a while longer.
The abyss has spat me out.
Fire licks my skin and I do not flinch.

lines.zh: 我摔在石头上，骨头又断。
lines.en: I hit the stone and another bone breaks.
Black water fills my throat, very cold.
The blast presses me to the wall.
I pull the arrow from my shoulder.

lines.zh: 法术的光，让我睁不开眼。
lines.en: The spell's light blinds me.

lines.zh: 饿到最后，只剩这副骨架。
lines.en: Hunger has left me only bones.
Lightning strikes and I laugh louder.

lines.zh: 虚空没有底，我一直在落。
lines.en: The void has no bottom; I keep falling.
